summary: Attr step 6 substitutes attribute text with an attribute context. Failure step 7 substitutes the fallback separately. Appendix A guards each substitution invocation, marks all contexts involved in matching-context recursion cyclic, and checks cyclic status again after nested substitutions. Therefore popping an input guard must not erase sticky markings on involved surrounding contexts. This supplies an API obligation, not a proof that native SCC invalidation already matches it.
